row.notes: myteam-g2: After a driver contract changes: if the old team is valid and the component is not in the AI-only mode (comp+0x3a0 == 0) and offer+8 > 0, posts a BankAccountTransactionMessage (vtbl 14568d508, category 0x14, kind 1) with amount offer+8 for the old team; then asks FUN_140dbb690 (lookup on comp+0x298->+0x730) and posts a second message (kind 2) for the new team with amount offer+4 minus the part already covered. Hook: offer+4/+8 are the fee/compensation amounts moved between team accounts.

verify.notes: V9021 First message: team = old key (id != 0x3fff), comp+0x3a0==0, offer+8>0, vtbl 14568d508, type byte 0x14 at msg+0x14, amount msg+0x18 = offer+8, kind msg+0x28=1. Second: FUN_140dbb690 quote on (comp+0x298)->+0x730 for new key, amount = offer+4 minus min(offer+4, quote), posted with kind 2 for the new team when nonzero. What comp+0x3a0 means (AI-only) is not provable from this code.
